description: Saritow Spinning Mills Limited was established in 1987 under the Saigol group of companies and incorporated in Pakistan as a public limited company; it is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange and is a spinning unit engaged in the manufacture and sale of yarn. Its mill is at 51-km Multan Road, Phool Nagar, District Kasur in Punjab, with the registered office at Gulberg in Lahore. It produces coarse and fine counts from 16/s to 80/s — carded, combed, slub, Lycra and Siro — in cotton, blended and synthetic yarn.
headOffice: 17-Aziz Avenue, Canal Bank, Gulberg-V, Lahore, Pakistan
